title: Information disclosure, sandbox escape in the Security: Process Sandboxing component
description: CVE-2026-8958 is a vulnerability in the Microsoft Security: Process Sandboxing component that can lead to information disclosure and sandbox escape. The affected version is 4.0. No CVSS score or detailed technical information is provided. No known exploits in the wild have been reported. No patch or remediation details are available in the provided data.
